admissibility_gates: both named tokenizer vocabularies load and all 15 fixed pairs are countable
the 5 x 3 scenario-by-form crossing is complete
no test sentence is copied from the proposal examples, original b8df44fa, or known replication 5ff2c6ad
no outcome-based gate: file regardless of sign

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.population: load-bearing task-state reports spanning stopping, scoped correctness, and unqualified handoff
estimand.baseline: complete careful English carrying the same claim: explicit no-result claim for stopped, explicit tested-condition boundary for done-under, and explicit permission for the named consumer to act without further work for complete-for
estimand.aggregation: equal weight per pair and per form; report the larger tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; preserve per-form decomposition

design.balance: complete 5 x 3 crossing; 15 fresh pairs, five per form
design.selection: all scenarios, English baselines, marked clauses, factors, and weights fixed before tokenisation; no sentence copied from the proposal examples, original manifest b8df44fa, or known replication 5ff2c6ad
